provenanceRepair.reviewFinding: The historical runner recursively discovered twelve conditional scripts/manifests absent from its frozen 83-artifact index and exited 1 at the reviewed candidate. Later additions also lie outside that frozen inventory. This failure does not establish corruption of a recorded artifact.
provenanceRepair.resolution: Verify each scope's explicit recorded entries under its pinned index identity. Never regenerate the old index from the enlarged working directory to force agreement.
provenanceRepair.behavior: Checks the two fixed index hashes, every explicitly recorded path/hash/byte-length entry, and the recorded files referenced by each indexed manifest. Traverses metadata values only; performs no filesystem discovery, producer import, golden regeneration, or writes.
provenanceRepair.limits: File-identity verification does not execute canonicalization, validate projection semantics, or replace production comparison and independent review. Unlisted later artifacts belong to another scope and are not silently enrolled.

authority.quotation: If the root ontology is anonymous, no subject is classified as external.

resolvedInterpretations.resolution: Every subject, including a named unrelated subject, is classified as local when the root ontology is anonymous. Design 14.3 supplies the explicit subject scope missing from the earlier reading of the B5 sentence alone.
